16"""Triton implementation of ``aten::ccol_indices`` for sparse CSC tensors. 

17 

18``ccol_indices(self)`` returns the compressed column pointer array of a sparse 

19CSC tensor as a zero-copy alias of the input's internal ccol storage: the 

20schema ``Tensor(a) self -> Tensor(a)`` makes the result an aliasing view, so 

21mutations written through the returned tensor are visible in the sparse tensor. 

22 

23The operator moves no data, so no kernel can implement it: a Triton kernel 

24would have to write a buffer, and any freshly written buffer would break the 

25aliasing contract. The GCU implementation therefore reads the stored buffer 

26directly (see below) and only falls back to the native accessor when the 

27tensor's components are not reachable through the backend component cache. 

28 

29Layout coverage mirrors native ATen exactly: only the column-compressed layouts 

30CSC and BSC carry a ccol buffer. CSR, BSR, COO and strided inputs are rejected 

31with the native ``RuntimeError`` message; the guard raises that identical 

32message itself because delegation cannot reach the native check for strided 

33tensors (the registrar also binds this implementation to the CUDA dispatch key, 

34so re-dispatching a strided input would re-enter this override and recurse 

35instead of surfacing the native error). 

36""" 

37 

38import logging 

39 

40import torch 

41 

42logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) 

43 

44# Layout constants and the native accessor are bound once so the hot path does 

45# no attribute lookup on ``torch``. 

46_L_CSC = torch.sparse_csc 

47_L_BSC = torch.sparse_bsc 

48_NATIVE_CCOL_INDICES = torch.Tensor.ccol_indices 

49 

50# C++ layout names as printed by native ATen in the rejection message of 

51# ``aten::ccol_indices`` (ATen/SparseCsrTensorUtils.h dispatch macro). Only 

52# column-compressed layouts (CSC/BSC) carry a ccol buffer; the mapping below 

53# covers every remaining standard layout so the mirrored message is 

54# byte-identical to the native one. 

55_NON_COLUMN_COMPRESSED_LAYOUT_NAMES = { 

56 torch.strided: "Strided", 

57 torch.sparse_coo: "Sparse", 

58 torch.sparse_csr: "SparseCsr", 

59 torch.sparse_bsr: "SparseBsr", 

60} 

61 

62# Component buffers of GCU compressed sparse tensors, populated by the wrapped 

63# ``torch.sparse_{csc,bsc}_tensor`` factories in ``values_copy`` and already 

64# used by the registered ``ccol_indices`` / ``values`` handlers of this 

65# backend. Reusing the same cache keeps this operator identical to the 

66# dispatcher-routed accessor while skipping the dispatcher itself. 

67try: 

68 from .values_copy import _components as _SPARSE_COMPONENTS 

69except Exception: # pragma: no cover - cache is an optional fast path 

70 _SPARSE_COMPONENTS = None 

71 

72 

73def ccol_indices(self: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor: 

74 """Return the compressed column indices of a sparse CSC/BSC tensor. 

75 

76 The result aliases the tensor's stored ccol buffer, matching 

77 ``aten::ccol_indices``. Batched CSC/BSC layouts keep their full batch 

78 shape, and the stored buffer's dtype (int64 or int32) is preserved, both 

79 exactly as the native reader reports them. 

80 """ 

81 if not isinstance(self, torch.Tensor): 

82 raise TypeError( 

83 f"ccol_indices: input must be a Tensor, got {type(self).__name__}" 

84 ) 

85 layout = self.layout 

86 if layout is _L_CSC or layout is _L_BSC: 

87 if _SPARSE_COMPONENTS is not None: 

88 entry = _SPARSE_COMPONENTS.get(id(self)) 

89 if entry is not None: 

90 # entry = [sparse, compressed(ccol), plain(row), values]; 

91 # ``detach`` mirrors the registered accessor and keeps the 

92 # shared storage, so callers observe the aliasing contract. 

93 return entry[1].detach() 

94 with torch._C._AutoDispatchBelowAutograd(): 

95 return _NATIVE_CCOL_INDICES(self) 

96 

97 layout_name = _NON_COLUMN_COMPRESSED_LAYOUT_NAMES.get(layout) 

98 if layout_name is None: 

99 # Unknown layout: fall through to the native op, which reports it. 

100 with torch._C._AutoDispatchBelowAutograd(): 

101 return _NATIVE_CCOL_INDICES(self) 

102 raise RuntimeError( 

103 "ccol_indices expected sparse column compressed tensor layout " 

104 f"but got {layout_name}" 

105 )
